title: Aureline M5 learning-state export bundles and reset plans
description: Boundary schema for the learning-state portability manifest. A learning-state export bundle is the support/export-safe packet that ports tour, exercise, or learning-session state out of the device to a portable profile, support bundle, or local download. It MUST preserve provenance back to the source state it carries, keep the state user-owned local-first, redact raw payloads, credential bodies, and absolute paths, and never widen data sharing. When display copy is localized, the bundle MUST keep a command-backed source-language escape so a reader can step back to the source-language original; localization changes display copy only and MUST preserve provenance. The pack the state was learned against discloses its cached/offline continuity: a non-live freshness state (mirror-synced, cached, local-only, or stale) MUST be disclosed, so a cached pack never masquerades as live; an undisclosed non-live pack narrows below Stable, and a disclosed cached/local-only/stale pack narrows to Beta with a named reason. A learning-state reset plan clears a bounded slice of learnability state: it declares an explicit target scope, lists the protected classes it preserves (it MUST protect docs packs, bookmarks, and user-authored notes so a reset never silently erases unrelated user-owned state), forbids deleting outside its scope, and keeps a command-backed, window-disclosed restore so reset is reversible. No export or reset path may introduce a tutorial-only mutating shortcut, bypass the standard preview/approval model when it touches real workspace state, change an authority boundary, or drift the command graph; exports and resets are user-initiated, never silent. Raw URLs, raw absolute paths, and raw credential material MUST NOT appear; the schema carries opaque ids, typed vocabulary, BCP-47 locale tags, and short privacy-safe labels only. The surface-family taxonomy aligns with schemas/learning/m5-feature-family-learning-rails.schema.json, the source/freshness vocabulary with schemas/help/m5-tour-and-glossary-packages.schema.json, and the verdict vocabulary with schemas/learning/guided-learning-contracts.schema.json. Adding a new record_kind, learnability state kind, protected class, export target, source class, freshness state, data-ownership class, or surface family is additive-minor; repurposing an existing value is breaking.

schema_version.description: Integer schema version for learning-state portability records. Current value is 1. Bumped only on breaking payload changes.

opaque_id.description: Opaque, stable identifier. Raw URLs, raw absolute paths, and raw secret material MUST NOT appear.

locale_tag.description: BCP-47 locale tag, e.g. en-US or fr-FR.

reason_array.description: Named narrowing reasons. Empty when the verdict is qualified_stable.

qualification_verdict.description: Derived lifecycle verdict for a record or the overall manifest.

learnability_state_kind.description: A class of learnability state an export or reset operation may touch.

protected_state_class.description: A class of user-owned state a reset MUST NOT delete. A reset MUST protect at least docs_pack, bookmark, and user_authored_note.

export_target_kind.description: Where a learning-state export is written.

source_class.description: Where the pack a learnability flow was learned against originates.

freshness_state.description: How current the pack is relative to the live authoritative source. Every non-live state MUST be disclosed.

data_ownership_class.description: Ownership class of the state. Only user_owned_local_first qualifies Stable.

m5_learning_surface_family.description: One M5 feature family a bundle belongs to.

redacts_raw_payloads.description: Whether the export redacts raw provider payloads. MUST be true.

redacts_credentials.description: Whether the export redacts credential bodies. MUST be true.

redacts_absolute_paths.description: Whether the export redacts raw absolute paths. MUST be true.

widens_data_sharing.description: Whether the export widens who can read the state. MUST be false.

introduces_tutorial_only_mutating_shortc.description: Whether the path introduces a tutorial-only mutating shortcut. MUST be false.

bypasses_preview_approval.description: Whether the path bypasses the standard preview/approval model. MUST be false.

touches_real_workspace_state.description: Whether the path touches real workspace state at all.

uses_standard_preview_approval_when_touc.description: Whether the path routes through the standard preview/approval model when it touches real workspace state. MUST be true when touches_real_workspace_state is true.

authority_boundary_change_allowed.description: Whether the path is allowed to change an authority boundary. MUST be false.

command_graph_unchanged.description: Whether the command graph stays unchanged. MUST be true.

allOf.description: A path that touches real workspace state must use the standard preview/approval model.

presented_localized.description: Whether the presented copy is localized away from its source language.

escape_to_source_available.description: Whether an escape to the source-language original is available. MUST be true when presented_localized is true.

escape_command_ref.description: Opaque ref to the command backing the source-language escape. MUST be present when presented_localized is true.

preserves_provenance.description: Whether localization preserves provenance (display copy only). MUST be true.

allOf.description: A localized presentation must carry a command-backed source-language escape.

continuity_disclosed.description: Whether a non-live freshness state is disclosed. MUST be true whenever freshness is not live_authoritative.

offline_mirror_ref.description: Opaque ref to the offline mirror the pack was served from, if any.

allOf.description: A mirror-synced pack must disclose its continuity.
A cached pack must disclose its continuity.
A local-only pack must disclose its continuity.
A stale pack must disclose its continuity.

source_state_refs.description: Opaque refs to the source state the bundle carries — the provenance trail.

provenance_preserved.description: Whether the export preserves provenance back to its source state. MUST be true.

safe_for_support_export.description: Whether the bundle is safe to include in support exports.

includes_progress_state.description: Whether the bundle includes step-level progress state.

user_initiated.description: Whether the export was user-initiated. MUST be true — no silent exports.

target_state_kinds.description: The learnability classes this reset clears.

protected_classes.description: The classes this reset preserves. MUST include docs_pack, bookmark, and user_authored_note.

silently_deletes_outside_scope.description: Whether the reset may delete state outside its declared scope. MUST be false.

restore_available.description: Whether a restore is available after the reset. MUST be true — reset is reversible.

restore_window_disclosed.description: Whether the restore window is disclosed. MUST be true when restore_available is true.

restore_command_ref.description: Opaque ref to the command backing the restore. MUST be present when restore_available is true.

safe_for_support_export.description: Whether the plan is safe to include in support exports.

user_initiated.description: Whether the reset was user-initiated. MUST be true — no silent resets.

allOf.description: A reset that offers a restore must disclose its window and back it with a command.

contract_refs.description: Schema, docs, and contract refs this manifest consumes.
